parole.significato: -un; used in borrowing certain European words that end in -um or one of its cognates.

parole.significato: a suffix used in Indo-European loanwords to form feminine abstract nouns

parole.significato: -ism: A suffix forming abstract nouns describing a condition or doctrine.

parole.significato: -logy: a combining form, forming nouns that denote fields of learning.
